scope: Planned client subtasks for the 16 baseline major areas; no future feature implementation is claimed.
estimate_basis: Client effort only, excluding backend implementation and documentation work recorded separately. Point estimates and rounded planning ranges are not measured time or probability bounds. Re-estimate selected work from current evidence.
schedule_policy: Windows reference the original delivery milestones only. They are tentative and do not reserve execution dates or establish capacity. Before activation, replan each selected task within 1–14 inclusive calendar days, with dependencies satisfied and a due date no later than 2026-11-20. If the complete baseline cannot fit, obtain an explicit scope decision without weakening safeguards.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.01 review current website rules and role changes
tasks.outcome: A dated Rider dependency review that distinguishes accepted, in-progress and unavailable web behavior.
implementation_steps: Read current courier, custody, validation, UI and backend roadmap sources.
Inspect relevant routes/services/tests and changes in buyer, seller, hub and admin behavior.
Record the source revision, relevant gaps and owning backend dependencies.
completion_checks: Each Rider capability has an authoritative source and current evidence.
Uncommitted or undeployed website work is labelled accurately; no backend files are changed.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.02 agree onboarding and access-state policy
tasks.outcome: An explicit native sign-in versus web onboarding decision with distinct account gates.
implementation_steps: Confirm existing courier login and approved web registration/recovery entry points.
Define pending, rejected, unplaced, inactive, suspended and unknown access responses.
Agree adult-worker/KYC, placement, duty and restricted-recovery ownership.
completion_checks: Platform approval, operational placement and duty remain separate.
No account role conversion or general suspended access is introduced.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.03 agree token and own-account contract
tasks.outcome: Reviewed auth/me examples for credentials, token lifecycle, capabilities and holding states.
implementation_steps: Specify login, token storage requirements, expiry/revocation and own-account resource fields.
Define rate-limit, wrong-role, invalid-credential, revoked and unavailable responses.
Obtain backend-owned contract examples and a native-auth implementation dependency.
completion_checks: Examples include positive and denied account combinations without secrets.
Sanctum dependency presence is not counted as working mobile authentication.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.04 agree queues and task-detail contract
tasks.outcome: Stable scoped assignment resources with capacity, next stop and permitted actions.
implementation_steps: Define pickup/final-mile references, list filters, sorting and bounded pagination.
Specify fresh task detail, stop/contact disclosure, cash applicability and action restrictions.
Map actual backend records without creating unnecessary job/task/trip storage models.
completion_checks: Available previews disclose less than owned active assignments.
Unknown stages, missing cash and foreign company/hub IDs have safe examples.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.05 freeze transport and data conventions
tasks.outcome: Consistent JSON envelopes, error categories, money, dates and compatibility rules.
implementation_steps: Agree IDs, UTC timestamps, Asia/Manila day filters and integer-centavo PHP amounts.
Specify validation/error envelopes, null/unknown handling and collection limits.
Define approved origins, additive versions and old-client capability behavior.
completion_checks: Fixtures decode unknown/missing fields without guessed values.
Pagination and redirects cannot send credentials outside the approved API origin.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.06 agree command replay and reconciliation
tasks.outcome: A single-intent protocol for duplicate, conflicting and lost-response mutations.
implementation_steps: Specify idempotency-key ownership, identical retry and mismatched-key behavior.
Define conflict/version responses and an owned command-status reconciliation path.
Agree side-effect rollback, storage failure and process-recreation examples.
completion_checks: A timed-out submit never implies local success or a newly generated retry intent.
Duplicate accepted commands retain one custody/evidence/cash event.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.07 agree pickup departure and proof payloads
tasks.outcome: Reviewed scan and outcome contracts that retain actual evidence and actor authority.
implementation_steps: Define matching submitted waybill and explicit scan-review-confirm fields.
Specify private proof MIME/size rules, recipient evidence and exact COD/no-COD semantics.
Confirm shared lifecycle services, allowed source states and immutable accepted evidence.
completion_checks: Wrong actor/hub/code and storage-failure examples cannot advance custody.
No stored-code autofill, public proof URL or buyer-completion command is accepted.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.08 agree failure return and restriction recovery contracts
tasks.outcome: Documented backend-owned failure reasons, held responsibility and narrow recovery resources.
implementation_steps: Specify allowed reasons, evidence, attempt number and hub-return instructions.
Agree refusal/third-failure RTS and hub-approved retry visibility.
Specify minimal restricted parcel/cash data and receiving-hub recovery authorization.
completion_checks: The rider cannot schedule retry, self-confirm hub receipt or mark returned.
Missing recovery/attempt persistence remains a visible backend prerequisite.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.09 agree chat history and notification resources

Define final-mile trip attribution, pagination, checkpoints and proof-access scope.
Agree persistent notification event IDs, recipients, read acknowledgements and safe links.

Polling is not treated as notification persistence or complete lifetime history.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.10 agree profile password and finance boundaries

Define held/remitted/discrepancy/reconciled cash and separate confirmed final-mile earnings.

No guessed earnings rate, wallet withdrawal or early seller-settlement state is exposed.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.11 agree staging and release compatibility

Document additive contract changes, older-client restrictions and rollback expectations.

tasks.title: rider-mobile/M01.12 publish reviewed consumer fixtures and API handoff

Reserve the single duty component and current-work summary.
Keep Home as the Tasks overview with readable phone spacing.
completion_checks: Unknown company/hub data stays explicitly missing/unassigned.
Header context remains usable with long names and large text.

Present scope/capacity reasons when available work is hidden.
Preserve the server order while filtering displayed records.

Counts describe returned or explicit server totals, never guessed lifetime results.

Render allowed/blocked action labels and missing-data explanations.
Use wrapping text, reachable controls and explicit details selection.
completion_checks: No generic client-owned status selector appears.

Removed/filtered tasks cannot leave stale actionable detail.

Present immutable destination/cash, permitted contacts and required evidence.
Show conflict/reassignment/terminal-state guidance without foreign identifiers.

Unknown/removed/foreign tasks fail safely and refresh the owned queue.
